name: agy-acp-map
description: Universal ACP v1/v2 bridge for Google Antigravity CLI (agy) supporting Zed, Cursor, and Electron Studio

scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.build:js: bun build src/sdk-server.ts --target node --outfile dist/bin.js && bun build src/index.ts --target node --outfile dist/index.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun test src/lib
scripts.smoke:all: bun test src/lib && bun tests/test-agy-args.ts && bun tests/smoke/smoke-basic.ts && bun tests/smoke/smoke-flags.ts && bun tests/smoke/smoke-permissions.ts && bun tests/smoke/smoke-image-in.ts && bun tests/smoke/smoke-image-out.ts && bun tests/smoke/smoke-robustness.ts

author: yitom
